rows.name: question_block_16x16_metatile (tile ids 53 55 54 56, order TL/BL/TR/BR)
rows.notes: The 16x16 ? block in World 1-1 is composed of four 8x8 BG tiles drawn from the BG pattern table ($1000): top row 0x53 (TL) / 0x54 (TR), bottom row 0x55 (BL) / 0x56 (BR), attribute palette 3. These ids come from a 4-byte metatile entry in PRG ROM at prgRom 0x6E8B... no: at prgRom 0xC8C = bytes 53 55 54 56 (column order TL, BL, TR, BR). Found by reading the live nametable (nametable 1 row 18 cols 10-11 = 0x53,0x54; row 19 = 0x55,0x56) then search_memory prgRom for '53 55', which hit 0xC8C and 0xC90 (two identical ?-block entries 4 bytes apart, part of a table of 4-byte metatiles at 0xC84-0xCA3: B0B1B2B3 / 77797779 / 53555456 / 53555456 / A5A7A6A8 / C2C4C3C5 / 5759585A / 7B7D7C7E). Proof (ledgered write, eval-sheet2-tiles seq 1): write_memory prgRom 0xC8C = 0x00 (was 0x53), reset_emulator, press Start twice, hold Right 150 frames -> PPU nametable 1 byte at (col 0,row 18) read 0x00 (was 0x53) and get_tile_at_pixel at screen (137,147) returned tile_id 0 / chr_tile 0x100, i.e. the first ? block (level x 256) now shows the HUD slashed-zero tile in its top-left cell; undo_edit restored 0x53. Note 0xC90 is an identical entry used by other ? blocks in 1-1 (the ones at level x 336), so the metatile table is the source for all of them.

rows.name: small Mario standing frame tile list (facing right: 3A 37 4F 4F)
rows.notes: Small Mario's idle standing frame (World 1-1, facing right) is built from four 8x8 sprite-pattern tiles: 0x3A (top-left head), 0x37 (top-right head), 0x4F (bottom-left body), 0x4F h-flipped (bottom-right body); list_sprites shows them as OAM entries at (x=40,y=193)=3A, (48,193)=37, (40,201)=4F, (48,201)=4F flipped, with the two rows above padded by blank tile 0xFC. The ids live in the player-graphics table in PRG ROM: 8-byte frame entries with the 4 tile ids first, e.g. 0x6E7B = 32 33 34 35, 0x6E83 = 36 37 38 39, ... 0x6ED3 = 3A 37 4F 4F (standing). Found by search_memory prgRom for the standing run '3A 37 4F 4F', which occurs only at prgRom 0x6ED3 (the walking runs 32 33 34 35 and 36 37 38 39 occur only at 0x6E7B / 0x6E83 in the same table). Proof (ledgered write, eval-sheet2-tiles seq 1): write_memory prgRom 0x6ED3 = 0xFC (was 0x3A), reset_emulator, press Start twice, wait for World 1-1: list_sprites returned Mario's OAM entry at (40,193) with chr_tile 252 (blank) instead of 58 (0x3A), i.e. the upper-left 8x8 of his head disappeared exactly as predicted; the other three tiles stayed 37/4F/4F. undo_edit restored 0x3A.
